title: MERGE BRIEF
intro: What you are about to merge, and what HQ knows about it.
noTask: No task is named. Open a brief from the PRs screen or from a ready action item.
noFactory: This HQ runs no factory, so it has no merge briefs.
failed: The brief could not be read.

why.no-pr: There is no pull request for this task yet.
why.test: At the test station. The checks are not all green.
why.review: At QC. The approvals are not met.
why.closed: The work was cancelled or the pull request was closed.
why.head-moved: The pull request on the host has a newer commit than HQ has checked.
why.no-checks: The host reports no check on this commit.
why.checks: The host shows a check that is not green.
why.approvals: The host does not show the approvals this needs.
why.unread: The host could not be read, so nothing is shown as ready.

noRisk: The work order sets no risk level.
readAt: Checks and reviews read from {{host}} at {{time}}.

verdict.changes: asked for changes in round {{round}} on
